news.headline: Bank Alfalah (BAFL) - Financial Results for the 2nd Quarter/Half Year Ended June 30, 2026 filed; specific PAT/EPS unconfirmed
news.summary: BAFL's DPS company page confirms a filing dated Jul 30, 2026 titled 'Financial Results for the 2nd Quarter/Half Year Ended June 30, 2026.' Two separate DPS fetches this cycle both returned a Profit after Taxation figure of Rs11,126,356 thousand for this filing - a figure that matches almost exactly BAFL's already-confirmed Q1 2026 (quarter ended March 31, 2026) PAT of Rs11.13bn/EPS Rs3.53 (per ProPakistani, published Apr 23, 2026), and is inconsistent with a separate ProPakistani analyst-survey piece ('Banks Expected to Report Lower Profits for Q2 2026,' published Jul 20, 2026) projecting BAFL's Q2 EPS to fall approximately 26% YoY - a genuine H1-cumulative PAT should exceed, not equal, the Q1-only figure. Per desk rules (no inferred prices; if the data layer doesn't have it, the answer is unknown), the specific H1/Q2 PAT and EPS are NOT logged as confirmed this cycle; only the fact that a results filing occurred is logged. No dividend figure independently confirmed either (most recent confirmed dividend on the DPS page remains the Rs1.50/share, 30% interim declared with Q1 results on May 19, 2026). Logged as impact 3 (notable, results date) for this core-tier bank pending confirmation of exact figures in a follow-up cycle.

news.headline: PPL discovers new oil and gas reserves in Sindh - fourth consecutive discovery in Shah Bandar Block (Rahi X-1 well)
news.summary: Pakistan Petroleum Limited (PSX: PPL) announced a new hydrocarbon discovery at the Rahi X-1 exploratory well in the Shah Bandar Exploration License, Sujawal district, Sindh - the fourth consecutive discovery in the block, following Benari X-1 (Dec 2018), Jhim East X-1 (2023) and Pateji X-1 (Nov 2024). Production testing yielded 12 barrels of oil per day (bopd) and 0.493 million standard cubic feet of gas per day (mmscfd) at a 32/64-inch choke. PPL is operator with 63% working interest; Mari Energies Limited (PSX: MARI) holds the remaining 32% participating interest. Per brokerage estimates cited in the article, the discovery could add approximately Rs0.036/share annually to PPL's earnings and approximately Rs0.042/share to Mari Energies' earnings, based on the tested production rate - a modest absolute production volume. Logged as impact 3 (notable company/sector news) for both PPL and MARI.

news.headline: SBP Reserves Down by $229 Million
news.summary: State Bank of Pakistan-held foreign exchange reserves fell $229 million over the week to $17.03bn, down from $17.259bn a week earlier (week ended July 24, 2026). Total liquid foreign reserves stood at $22.442bn, comprising $17.030bn held by the SBP and $5.412bn held by commercial banks. Routine weekly reserves data, consistent in kind with prior weekly reserve items already logged this newslog; logged as impact 2 (minor/background).

news.headline: Security Papers (SEPL) declares Rs9/share dividend as FY2026 net profit falls 40% to Rs907.16m
news.summary: Security Papers Limited (PSX: SEPL) reported a 40% decline in net profit for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, to Rs907.16m from Rs1.52bn in the preceding year (FY2025 net profit of Rs1,524m, per prior reporting, had itself included an interim Rs2.50/share dividend plus a final Rs9.00/share dividend, Rs11.50/share total for FY2025). The board declared a cash dividend of Rs9.00 per share for FY2026; no EPS figure disclosed in the source reviewed. Logged as impact 3 (notable results + dividend declaration) for this small-weight, listed-tier universe constituent.

news.headline: PSX Closing Bell: A Touch of Red - KSE-100 confirmed Thursday close down 495.00 points (-0.28%)
news.summary: Thursday session (this checkpoint), from Wednesday's confirmed close of 176,042.99: KSE-100 settled at 175,547.98, down 495.00 points (-0.28%), per Mettis Global's 'PSX Closing Bell: A Touch of Red' (mettisglobal.news/latest) and corroborated by Express Tribune ('PSX falls 495 points as US-Iran tensions overshadow market') and PSX's own DPS indices page (captured Jul 30, 2026 3:50pm PKT, showing the same 175,547.98 level and -495.00-point move). Mettis attributes the session to persistent selling pressure in key sectors amid continued uncertainty over regional geopolitical tensions; oil & gas, cement and investment-bank names cited as laggards, fertiliser and commercial-bank names cited as relatively supportive. A modest continuation of the Middle East-tension-driven risk-off pattern already logged this cycle at higher impact; logged as impact 2 (background, sub-1% single-session move) for the index-level print.

news.summary: Per Mettis Global's latest-news feed (mettisglobal.news/latest, checked 2026-07-30): the Special Convertible Rupee Account (SCRA) balance fell Rs82m to Rs27.3bn; the rupee posted a slight gain to settle at Rs277.81/USD in the interbank market; Tasdeeq's IPO floor price was set at Rs1.90/share (not a universe constituent); and the Prime Minister ordered a crackdown on tax evaders and the informal economy. Routine/background administrative and macro items, no PSX-ticker-level figures disclosed beyond the aggregate rupee/SCRA prints already consistent in kind with prior entries this newslog; logged as impact 1 (routine/administrative).

news.headline: Govt hikes petrol by Re1.09, HSD by Rs2.42 per litre
news.summary: Published Jul 30, 2026 11:47pm PKT: government raised ex-depot fuel prices - petrol +Re1.09 to Rs336.15/litre (from Rs335.06), HSD +Rs2.42 to Rs393.04/litre (from Rs390.62). Mettis's article states an 'Effective Date: July 31, 2026'; a separate ARY News report on the same hike described it as effective August 1, 2026 - the two sources disagree on the effective date and both are quoted here as found, unreconciled. Magnitude is far smaller than the Jul 11, 2026 hike (petrol +Rs13.18, HSD +Rs13.80, logged at impact 4); logged as impact 2 (minor, routine ex-depot price revision) per desk scale, with read-through for OMC (PSO) and refiners (ATRL, NRL, PRL).

First EFERT entry in this newslog. Logged as impact 4 (earnings surprise - a 32% YoY profit decline per the Tribune figure) per desk news-impact criteria (Rule 10) pending reconciliation of the conflicting PAT/EPS figures in a follow-up cycle; escalation flagged.
